title: 分支是指向 commit 的指针
expected_output:
分支是指向 commit 的指针
  .git/HEAD 内容: ref: refs/heads/main
  .git/refs/heads/main 内容: b850b4fe9a65a5cd556b972a2d91c60bb67a5f37
  .git/refs/heads/dev   内容: b850b4fe9a65a5cd556b972a2d91c60bb67a5f37
  git rev-parse main == HEAD: True
  main 与 dev 指向同一 commit: True
结论: 分支只是 41 字节的文件，存一个 commit SHA；切换/新建分支只改引用，开销极小
code:
import os, subprocess, tempfile, hashlib, pathlib

GIT_ENV = dict(os.environ)
for _k, _v in [("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_AUTHOR_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")]:
    GIT_ENV[_k] = _v

def g(args, cwd):
    r = subprocess.run(["git"] + args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s failed:\n%s" % (args, r.stderr))
    return r.stdout

def new_repo():
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="repo_")
    g(["init", "-q", "-b", "main"], d)
    g(["config", "user.name", "dev"], d)
    g(["config", "user.email", "dev@example.com"], d)
    g(["config", "commit.gpgsign", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.autocrlf", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.eol", "lf"], d)
    return d

def w(d, name, content):
    p = pathlib.Path(d) / name
    if isinstance(content, str):
        p.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
    else:
        p.write_bytes(content)

def blob_sha(content_bytes):
    b = content_bytes.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(content_bytes, str) else content_bytes
    h = hashlib.sha1()
    h.update(b"blob " + str(len(b)).encode() + b"\x00" + b)
    return h.hexdigest()


d = new_repo()
w(d, "a.txt", "x\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "c1"], d)
g(["branch", "dev"], d)
main_ref = pathlib.Path(d, ".git", "refs", "heads", "main").read_text().strip()
dev_ref = pathlib.Path(d, ".git", "refs", "heads", "dev").read_text().strip()
head_ref = pathlib.Path(d, ".git", "HEAD").read_text().strip()
main_sha = g(["rev-parse", "main"], d).strip()
print("分支是指向 commit 的指针")
print("  .git/HEAD 内容: " + head_ref)
print("  .git/refs/heads/main 内容: " + main_ref)
print("  .git/refs/heads/dev   内容: " + dev_ref)
print("  git rev-parse main == HEAD: " + str(main_sha == g(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], d).strip()))
print("  main 与 dev 指向同一 commit: " + str(main_ref == dev_ref))
print("结论: 分支只是 41 字节的文件，存一个 commit SHA；切换/新建分支只改引用，开销极小")
